spark_open.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, horse-proportioned animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of sparse grass and dirt. Its overall body shape, head, legs and hooves are those of a horse, but almost the entire dorsal and lateral surface is covered in dense, overlapping, rounded scales in mottled brown and tan resembling pangolin armor. The scales cover the neck, back, sides, rump, outer surfaces of all four legs, the long tapering tail, and the forehead and crown between the ears. The face, muzzle, ears, and the ventral belly and inner upper legs retain short hair; the facial hair is brown with a dark muzzle and nostril, the belly and inner leg fur is pale cream to light tan, and the lower legs have a fringe of brown hair just above the hooves. The head is held at shoulder height with ears erect, and all four hooved feet are on the ground. The tail hangs vertically behind the hind legs.

meta_spark.description: A four-legged animal with the overall body shape, head, and stance of a horse standing in three-quarter profile facing right. Its head, ears, muzzle, and hooved lower legs are brown and horse-like, while the top of its head, neck, back, sides, outer surfaces of all four legs, and long tapering tail are densely covered in overlapping brown scales. The underside of the torso, chest, and inner upper legs show pale tan shaggy fur. It stands on a small patch of dirt with sparse grass.
